scientific_integrity: All mathematical claims are restricted to the proved asymptotic and structural properties; numerical tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The constant is specified as the least real part of a zero of an explicit entire function, not as a certified decimal.
The proof does not identify which particular numbered limiting zero minimizes the real part.
Older section-zero literature could contain an equivalent result; full-text access to Love (1949) was unavailable.
title: A sharp inverse-degree radial law for Landau's binomial sections
